lessonsAdded: Before swapping on an EVM chain, hold its native coin for gas (ETH on Base), and if you do not, bridge some there first (for example SOL or USDC on Solana to ETH on Base).
When a symbol is shared by several tokens, search, compare liquidity, verification and age, and trade the mint address of the real one, because clones with tiny liquidity are traps.
Put a stop_loss_price on every perps order with 3x leverage or more, above the liquidation price for a long and below it for a short.
Keep buying the next coin that cites organic at least 75, LP locked, mint and freeze revoked, and 5-minute net buying, because LAUNCH is open +$0.28 and HOOKED is open +$0.02 on that setup.
Size a coin at $3 when organic is 75 to 79 and the other three entry facts are cited, because both open winners were entered near $3.
Do not skip the next coin that passes those four checks just because another open position is red or flat, because one unfinished dip is not a failed pattern and both new entries are green.

In the same order as the buy, set a hard stop 20% below entry that sells 100% and a take profit about 20% above entry that sells 50%, because HOOKED used that pair and is open +$0.02 while LAUNCH, also with a stop and a half-size target, is open +$0.28.

If LP lock falls from 100% at entry to under 20% while price is flat, sell 100% immediately, because that exit cut HOOKED to -$0.05 instead of holding an unlocked pool.

In the same order as the buy, set a hard stop 20% below the fill that sells 100% and a take profit 20% above the fill that sells 50%, then trail the rest, because that take profit booked +$0.33, the trail added +$0.01, and the stop capped the re-entry at -$0.62.

If quoted price impact is above 2%, cut the buy size until impact is 2% or less and still take the trade, because one swap paid 3.8% impact and spent edge on entry.
